inputSemantics: req_domain_admit (binary; fact: scripts/approve-domain.sh prepare (admission request); partial): a domain admission is requested
lane_principal_distinct (binary; fact: lifecycle extension: approver != preparer and not an agent (T15); new): the acting principal is distinct from the preparer and human
reserved: lane_in_workflow (lifecycle frame lane 2; the asset is in its workflow)
reserved: lane_re_pinned (lifecycle frame lane 3; a frame document has been re-pinned (T16))
reserved: lane_approved (lifecycle frame lane 4; approved by a distinct human principal)
reserved: lane_rework (lifecycle frame lane 5; rework requested)
reserved: lane_step_running (lifecycle frame lane 6; a step is running)
reserved: lane_stale (lifecycle frame lane 7; the head is STALE (continuation TTL or lease expired))
prep_completed (binary; aigov-dossier-preparer completion via aigov.gov01.dossier-preparer.completion): the dossier draft is complete
prep_failed (binary; aigov-dossier-preparer completion via aigov.gov01.dossier-preparer.completion): the agent's step failed
sections_unresolved (binary; aigov-dossier-preparer completion via aigov.gov01.dossier-preparer.completion): sections left unresolved for the author
lane_diff_rendered (binary; fact: GOV11 diff renderer completion, carried by the frame; new): the canonical diff of the exact revision was shown to the reviewer
comp_iso42005_signed (binary; fact: document-workflow close of the frame's ISO/IEC 42005 assessment; partial): ISO/IEC 42005 impact assessment signed
comp_eu_fria_signed (binary; fact: document-workflow close of the frame's Art. 27 FRIA; partial): EU AI Act Art. 27 FRIA signed
gate_redteam_pass (binary; fact: adversarial evaluation (AgentDojo and the domain suite); new): red-team suite passed, no unmitigated T13 bypass
gate_source_slsa_attested (binary; fact: provenance attestation (verify-build-provenance.py today; SLSA/in-toto new); partial): Sources and builds are attested

governance.escalationPolicy: AIGOV::Governance Steward -> AIGOV::Approval Quorum; agents never resume an approval continuation (T15)
